descriptive_reporting.training_loss_policy: Training loss is optimization diagnostics only and will not be interpreted as evidence for the research hypothesis.

label_handling.macro_f1: Unweighted arithmetic mean of class-wise F1 over all three fixed labels.

primary_confirmatory.direction: Positive values indicate higher TARGETED macro-F1.

primary_external_evaluation.gold_policy: Gold labels remain sealed until predictions from all 12 fixed-final primary models are generated and SHA-frozen.
primary_external_evaluation.model_selection: No checkpoint, seed, condition, or hyperparameter selection may use Test500.

purpose: Prospectively freeze the statistical analysis plan after all 12 primary models were trained but before Test500 gold labels were unsealed.

reporting_constraints.hypothesis_language: Conclusions must distinguish primary Test500 evidence from secondary diagnostics and exploratory observations.

secondary_diagnostics.policy: Secondary diagnostics may characterize failure modes but cannot replace or override the primary Test500 conclusion.

seed_aggregation.paired_seed_deltas: Condition contrasts use matched seeds: 42 with 42, 43 with 43, and 44 with 44.

uncertainty.interpretation: Report effect estimates and confidence intervals. No null-hypothesis significance-test p-values are planned.
procedure: For each bootstrap replicate, sample 3 seed IDs with replacement from [42, 43, 44].
Sample 500 Test500 item indices with replacement.
Use the same sampled item indices for every condition and every sampled matched-seed comparison.
For each sampled seed and condition, compute the metric on the bootstrap item sample.
Average the metric across the 3 sampled seeds to obtain one bootstrap condition-level estimate.
For each pre-specified contrast, subtract comparator from TARGETED within the same bootstrap replicate.
Report the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the 10,000 bootstrap differences as the 95% interval.
